inspection: Assistant inspected actual frame-2.png pixels for all twelve final states using cognition_image_view; not inferred from metadata. Frame-1 captures are hash/provenance checked, not separately pixel-inspected.
origin: Native macOS GPU pre-present surface copy; synthetic preset model/focus/scroll, not human input or after-present/compositor confirmation.
limitations: Pre-present surface copies, not compositor or physical monitor confirmation.
Preset model/focus/scroll state is synthetic, not physical input.
Fixed-width columns clip long labels; narrow layout scrolls rather than auto-fitting all data.
Physical input, live OS IME, live AT and Windows/Linux were not verified.

states.name: light
states.finding: Visible table values and selected row, grouped fields and explicit commit/cancel. The earlier zero-height cells and fractional-width percent soft-wrap are corrected.

states.name: dark
states.finding: Readable shared dark theme with retained selected row and raised inspector surfaces.

states.name: narrow
states.finding: 380-point viewport: toolbar stacks, panes stack vertically; fixed-width columns intentionally require horizontal table scrolling and lower panes require outer scrolling.

states.name: narrow-inspector
states.finding: Outer scroll preset reaches property text/number/boolean editors. Inspector itself scrolls to lower properties/actions.

states.name: compact-hc-200
states.finding: Both UI and reading scales at 200%; compact high-contrast toolbar/title remain rendered and vertically scrollable. Table lies below the first viewport.

states.name: compact-hc-200-inspector
states.finding: Outer scroll reaches enlarged code/text fields and explicit Commit/Cancel. Fixed-width headers/cells can clip long labels by declared policy; no autosize or ellipsis claimed.

states.name: compact-hc-200-bottom
states.finding: Inspector scroll reaches enlarged workflow Boolean/Choice controls and commit/cancel actions.

states.name: invalid
states.finding: Focused numeric intermediate dash remains editable; invalid feedback and disabled Commit are visible, with focused field background/caret.

states.name: readonly
states.finding: Read-only status and inactive commit/cancel are visible without hiding values; copy/focus policy is separately unit-tested.

states.name: disabled
states.finding: Disabled table/inspector show values but no actionable focus/edit permission. Final preset no longer panics on a forbidden disabled selection setter.

states.name: empty
states.finding: Table no-record feedback and inspector no-selection feedback are visible; reset remains available.

states.name: workflow-bottom
states.finding: Inner inspector scroll exposes Boolean draft, stable-ID choice draft and explicit lower actions.
